name: Hyakki Shachuu
source:
Hyakki Shachuu is a group of people in Isedaikagura.
They perform rituals around the town, so called Kagura.

On the other hand, they exorcise evil beings at night.

Five men fight against youkai (ghouls) and go forward their way of the art.
A Shousetsu Yuugai's romantic youkai story.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ212909.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
百鬼社中是伊势神乐的一群人。
他们在城镇周围举行仪式，即所谓的神乐。

另一方面，他们在夜间驱邪。

五名男子与妖怪战斗，并继续他们的艺术之路。
少女游外的浪漫妖怪故事。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ212909.html/]DLsite英文[/url]]
